purpose: Source-only diagnostic audit of15 film groups and4 additional lists. Groups contain multiple assertions, not an atomic recall denominator.

Streaming, rental, ad-supported and library-card terms largely remain separate per service.
Twilight1998 remains distinct from vampire title references; NightmareAlley1947/2021 have separate identities2447/2645.
Viewer-prank violence remains a hypothetical reviewer joke, not a film-plot fact.
Editorial recommendation groups remain reported categories, not automatically ontological subclasses.
remaining_limits: Brick director assertion is missing and one Detour platform is omitted despite technical completion.
The first supplementary list has no addressable film members; other lists do.

Access-mode strings vary across Rent/Rental/Rentable and FreeViewing/FreeStreaming; conditions appear in different fields. Retained meaning alone does not ensure a single exact literal filter retrieves every option.
Actor/Director classes were created during ingestion; earlier objects often remain Person, so class-only selection is not a complete professional population.
Overlapping review and comparative facts remain; count/connectedness cannot establish retrieval usefulness.
